questions.question:
Given below is an inequality, which of the following condition is TRUE?

If P ≤ Q ≥ R; E ≥ Q; L < Q = D
questions.solution:
Given inequality is: P ≤ Q ≥ R; E ≥ Q; L < Q = D

1. L < P → P ≤ Q, L < Q, data is not sufficient to determine the relation → False

2. E ≥ R → E ≥ Q ≥ R, E ≥ R → True.

3. E < D → E ≥ Q, L < Q = D, E ≥ D → False.

4. Q < R → Q ≥ R → False.

Hence, E ≥ R, is the correct inequality.

questions.question:
**Directions**: In each question below is given one/more statements that followed by two assumptions numbered I and II. Consider the statement and decide which of the given assumptions is implicit.

**Statement: **Vinayak wrote the second letter to Queen after a month as he did not receive any reply to the first letter.

**Assumptions:**

I. The letter generally reaches within a fortnight

II. Queen usually replies to Vinayak’s letter

options.text: Both I and II are implicit
Neither I nor II is implicit

questions.solution:
Nothing about the time taken by the letter to reach is mentioned or suggested in the given statement.

Hence, the assumption I is not implicit.

As Vinayak has written a second letter, he is expecting a reply for it despite not receiving a reply to his first letter.

Therefore, it can be said that the queen usually gives reply to his letters.

Hence, assumption II is implicit.

Thus, only assumption II is implicit.

questions.question: While traveling by bus, a man spent Rs. 60 more than 10 times the fare he paid for an auto rickshaw. The total amount spent by him is 13 times the fare he paid for an auto rickshaw. What total amount of money was spent on Bus as well as Auto rickshaw by the man?
questions.solution:
Let, Man spend fare for auto rickshaw = a ------(i)

Then, Man spend fare for Bus = 10a + 60 Rs ------(ii)

Total amount spent by him = 13a ------(iii)

According to question,

Eq (i) + Eq (ii) = Eq(iii)

a + 10a + 60 = 13a

2a = 60

a = 30

Man spend fare for auto rickshaw = 30 Rs

Man spend fare for Bus = 300 + 60 = 360 Rs

Total amount of money was spent on Bus as well as Auto rickshaw by the man = 360 + 30

= 390 Rs

Hence, 390 is the correct answer.

questions.question: The average age of 17 persons is 39 years. If the average age of the first 9 persons is 35 years, and the average age of the last 9 persons is 44 years, what is the age of the 9th person?
questions.solution:
We know that

**Average age = Total age of all persons ÷ total persons**

So,

**Total age of all persons = Average age × total persons**

Given:

**1) Average age of 17 persons is 39 years.**

Total age of all persons = Average age × total persons

= 39 × 17

= 663

2) Average age of the first 9 persons is 35 years.</stron

In a certain code language, 'HEG' is coded as '840', 'JFD' is coded as '720'. What is the code for 'JDK' in that code language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Logic: (Product of the place value of the letters) × 3 = Code.

Now,

‘HEG' is coded as '840’

⇒ H(8) × E(5) × G(7)

⇒ (8 × 5 × 7) × 3 

⇒ 280 × 3 = 840.

For, ‘JFD' is coded as '720’

⇒ J(10) × F(6) × D(4)

⇒ (10 × 6 × 4) × 3 

⇒ 240 × 3 = 720.

Similarly, for ‘**JDK**’

**⇒ J(10) × D(4) × K(11)**

**⇒ (10 × 4 × 11) × 3 **

**⇒ 440 × 3 = 1320.**

So, '**JDK**' will be coded as '**1320**'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.

questions.question: Four number-pairs are given, out of which three are alike in some way or the other, and one is different. Select the odd number-pair.
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: 1st number = (2nd number **÷** 2) **× 3

Checking all the options one by one:

**1) 112 : 70 → **(70 ÷ 2) × 3** = 35 **× 3 = **105 ≠ **1st number

2) 39 : 26 → (26 ÷ 2) × 3 = 13 × 3 = 39 = 1st Number

3) 63 : 42 → (42 ÷ 2) × 3 = 21 × 3 = 63 = 1st Number

4) 30 : 20 → (20 ÷ 2) × 3 = 10 × 3 = 30 = 1st Number

Hence, the correct answer is** "112 : 70".**

questions.question:
In the question below is given a statement followed by some courses of action. You have to assume everything in the statement to be true and on the basis of the information given in the statement, decide which of the suggested course of action logically follow(s) for pursuing.

**Statement**: While you are working at a Multinational company in a Metropolitan city, you notice your colleague having acute chest pain and you realize that it could be a Heart Attack.

options.text: Call Ambulance and wait till it arrives.
Take him to the hospital as soon as possible in your private vehicle.
Ask your other colleagues to help him as you have a major assignment to be submitted by the end of the day.
Ask your Boss to take the responsibility of taking him to the hospital.

questions.solution:
The Logic here is as follows: 

__
 
• The correct answer is **Option 2**: Take him to the hospital as soon as possible

in your private vehicle.

 

 
 

 **Course of Action**
 **Correction**
 **Reasoning**
 
 

 Call Ambulance and wait till it arrives.
 Incorrect
 During a Heart Attack, the first 30mins are very crucial. Hence, waiting for the Ambulance to arrive can actually make the condition worst.
 
 

 Take him to the hospital as soon as possible in your private vehicle.
 Correct
 This is correct because, taking the person to the hospital as soon as possible during the Heart Attack can actually save his life, as the first 30mins are very important.
 
 

 Ask your other colleagues to help him as you have a major assignment to be submitted by the end of the day.
 Incorrect
 This would be Incorrect because doing this would be very Selfish, as you think your work is more important than the life of a person.
 
 

 Ask your Boss to take the responsibility of taking him to the hospital.
 Incorrect
 This would be Incorrect because you have no power to give order to your Boss.
 
 

 

 
• Qualities Projected in this situation: (Sens of responsibility,

Effective intelligence, and speed of decision).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• Checklist for attempting Course of Action questions:

 
• Read the question and options carefully.
 
• Look for options that are realistic, optimistic, and reflect officer-like qualities.
 
• Do not skip any situation.
 
• Relegate the negative sentences and choose the most logical option among the remaining ones. As time is an important factor, hence your thinking ability should be swift.
 
• React quickly and be logical.

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

K _ _ N L _ N K _ N _ L N K _ M _ L M _

options.text: L, M, M, M, K, L, K, N
L, M, M, K, K, L, N, N
M, M, L, K, K, L, K, N
L, M, M, K, K, M, K, N

questions.solution:
Given:- K _ _ N L _ N K _ N _ L N K _ M _ L M _

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1) **L, M, M, M, K, L, K, N** → K** L M **N, L **M **N K, **M **N **K **L, N K **L **M, **K **L M **N**

2) L, M, M, K, K, L, N, N → K L M N, L M N K, **K **N K L, N K L M, N L M N

3) M, M, L, K, K, L, K, N → K M M N, L **L **N K, **K** N K L, N K L M, K L M N

4) L, M, M, K, K, M, K, N → K L M N, L M N K, **K** N K L, N K **M** M, K L M N

The logic here is that all the 4 letters (K,L,M,N) should be there in the group of four and in all the options except 1 they are being repeated.

 
• Option (1) give a pattern of K L M N - L M N K - M N K L - N K L M - K L M N

Hence, the correct answer is **"L, M, M, M, K, L, K, N".**

questions.question:
Three statements are followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. You have to consider these statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts. Decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the given statements.

**Statements:**

All potatoes are tomatoes.

All tomatoes are brinjals.

All brinjals are onions.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some onions are potatoes

(II) All tomatoes are potatoes

(III) No tomato is a potato

options.text: Either conclusion I or III follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b9668ed5b5d7914bbeda3a696f36cbf99e07e54a288e0daefbff8654c8027ce2.png] 

Conclusions:

I) Some onions are potatoes → Follows (Above diagram shows there is a relation between onions and potatoes)

II) All tomatoes are potatoes → Doesn't follows (The relation between tomatoes and potatoes is all potatoes are tomatoes.)

III) No tomato is a potato → Doesn't follows (The relation between tomatoes and potatoes is all potatoes are tomatoes.)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion I follows****"**.
